content.thinking: This points to silent data corruption rather than a bad deployment — the code change likely stopped carrying the month total forward, so stored totals are stale or wrong even though metrics look flat. It's a code issue, not config, so I'll classify it as silent-data-corruption with bad-deployment as the secondary possibility.

hypotheses.subject: purchase_ledger.record_purchase (revision 26f1d7e2c82ce2abff8f9b6424dc226f4f37fed2)
hypotheses.summary: Deploy 26f1d7e2 changed record_purchase in purchase_ledger.py so it no longer maintains total_this_month_cents on the account. Totals written since 2026-10-05T22:35 are therefore wrong, and every shopper total is now out of step with its purchases. The service stayed fast and error-free, and no series moved. Reverting stops further drift but does not repair the records already written, which need a rewrite.

supporting_evidence.claim: 240 of 240 shopper totals do not reconcile with the purchases behind them... oldest affected purchase was recorded at 2026-10-05T22:37:00Z
